summary: Radius growth instantly increases overlap of open contacts; no per-step limit, no timestep re-check, no energy tally
failure_scenario: Swelling/growth run injects elastic energy (Hertz dU~E*sqrt(R)*d^1.5*dr) and may violate Rayleigh/Hertz dt as radius grows; particles explode or bed heats artificially without diagnostic
evidence_ref: inspection; LAMMPS fix granular/mdr handles apparent-radius history (https://docs.lammps.org/pair_granular.html)
recommendation: Add max_growth_per_step keyword, re-run FixCheckTimestepGran after growth, compute_scalar injected energy; V&V V-E3 energy balance within 1%

summary: History spring projected onto tangent plane without magnitude rescale or rotation with mean spin; displacement-based Mindlin with kt(delta) has no incremental-force/rescale variant
failure_scenario: Rotating contacts (rolling particles, oblique impacts CO-4..CO-8) lose shear-spring magnitude each step; loading/unloading with varying kt can create spurious work (Thornton et al. 2013)
evidence_ref: LAMMPS gran_sub_mod_tangential.cpp:121-200 rotate_rescale_vec (Luding 2008 eq.17; Thornton 2013 eq.18), :339-474 mindlin/force & mindlin_rescale
recommendation: Add opt-in 'rescale on' (project+rescale) and incremental-force Mindlin variant; keep legacy default like LAMMPS linear_history_classic; V&V Chung&Ooi CO-4..CO-8 and V-E1

summary: No balance/fix balance; static uniform brick decomposition although Comm has non-uniform xsplit hooks
failure_scenario: Hopper/chute/insertion-stream runs at >=16 ranks: most ranks idle while few ranks hold the pile; strong scaling flattens
evidence_ref: LAMMPS src/balance.cpp, fix_balance, imbalance_neigh.cpp (https://docs.lammps.org/fix_balance.html); Eibl & Ruede CPC 244 (2019) 76
recommendation: Port LAMMPS balance/fix balance shift style with weights 1+c*npartner(+mesh contacts); verify parallel mesh re-ownership; RCB later; accept on B-1 silo imbalance <1.2

summary: History models require newton pair off; ghost pairs computed twice

recommendation: Port pre_exchange_newton with reverse comm of npartner and history; apply j-side forces/torques under newton; audit per-model history sign; accept CO-1..8 parity + B-1 pair-time

summary: Linear tag scan of partners during neighbor build; cost never measured

recommendation: Add npartner/scan counters first; only if >5% of Neigh time implement tag-sorted partner lists + merge-join; do not implement hash map

summary: No OpenMP granular kernels; MPI-only
failure_scenario: On many-core nodes users must run one rank per core increasing ghost/comm volume and imbalance; cannot use hybrid MPI+threads
evidence_ref: LAMMPS src/OPENMP/pair_gran_hooke_history_omp.cpp:75-105 (per-thread f/torque arrays + reduce_thr)
recommendation: Add ThrData-style per-thread force/torque buffers and ordered reduction for pair gran and wall/gran; accept B-1 MPIxOMP matrix and bitwise equality for fixed thread count

summary: Granular neighbor multi restricted; single max-cutoff bins
failure_scenario: Polydisperse systems (size ratio >=5) over-search stencils by up to ~ratio^3 candidates; neigh time dominates
evidence_ref: LAMMPS neigh_modify collection/type|interval (https://docs.lammps.org/neigh_modify.html); Shire, Hanley & Stratford Comp. Part. Mech. 8 (2021) 653

summary: Removed generic fallback; unlisted combinations hard-error

recommendation: Restore a correct runtime-composed fallback (virtual per slot) with one-time warning; CMake auto-whitelist from examples/tests; accept V-R1 fallback==static to 1e-14 and <1.5x pair time

summary: Only Finnie-type wear (f(gamma)*k*|v|*|F|), zero for pure sliding; no Archard/Oka; no geometry update

summary: generalized_adhesion F=w*pi*R*delta (Hertz area proxy) vanishes at contact; coefficient is a stress but named adhesionEnergy; no JKR/DMT pull-off; no auto type-pair mixing

evidence_ref: LAMMPS pair granular jkr/dmt (https://docs.lammps.org/pair_granular.html); JKR 1971; DMT 1975; Thornton & Ning 1998; EEPA Thakur 2014
